content.title: XO, Kitty Season 3: Release time, episode count, and that MAJOR CAMEO explained
content.text: Story highlightsKitty's first day of senior year has finally arrived. The most anticipated show, XO, Kitty, is returning with a new season. It follows her chaotic love story with Min-ho and her enrollment in her senior year at KISS, Seoul. Ready for an adventurous ride through Kitty’s life? The day has finally arrived! XO, Kitty Season 3 is just a few hours away from its premiere on Netflix today, April 2, 2026. This final season follows Kitty Song Covey (Anna Cathcart) as she returns to the Korean Independent School of Seoul (KISS) for her senior year, diving into chaos, romance, and self-discovery across eight new episodes.Release Time of season 3The series has been dropped at 12 AM PT on Netflix. The exact time that it comes out in your country will depend on where you live in the world and what your time zone is. In the UAE, it will be available at 11 AM, and in Korea, the viewers can watch it at 4 PM KST.Release time in IndiaTrending StoriesThe audience in India can watch it at 12:30 PM IST. Youngsters, primarily Gen Z and younger Millennials, mostly captivate the craze for XO, Kitty season 3. It stems from its binge-worthy drama, which includes high-stakes teenage romance and emotions.About XO, Kitty Season 3Netflix surprised fans of XO, Kitty, with the release of the Season 3 trailer on March 9, 2026, highlighting her return to the Korean Independent School of Seoul (KISS) for her senior year. The fans also spotted a special appearance, which was a cameo by Lana Condor (Lara Jean), that sparked delight among the viewers. The show will also feature returning stars, including Minyeong Choi (Dae), Gia Kim (Yuri), and Sang Heon Lee (Min Ho).About the AuthorVanshika Raghav is an entertainment journalist specializing in celebrity news, trending pop culture, and SEO-driven content, she turns viral moments into scroll-stopping stories.
